OUR STORY

Two flags, one family table

BMCA began as a handful of Malayalee families in Bexhill-on-Sea meeting for Onam sadya on banana leaves in someone's front room. Today it's grown into a full community — but the spirit hasn't changed: everyone brings a dish, everyone's children learn a step of Thiruvathira, and everyone is welcome regardless of faith, from Kerala's Hindu, Christian and Muslim traditions alike.

We run festival celebrations, Malayalam language sessions for children, sports days, and support for newly arrived families settling into Sussex life — a soft landing with a familiar smell of coconut oil and cardamom.
